{"id": "2:219/q27", "question": "What does ٱلْعَفْوَ mean as the amount to spend?", "turns_on": "The word is explained through surplus, ease, moderation, quality, obligatory alms, or a freely offered amount.", "positions": [{"id": "2:219/q27/p1", "position": "Give the surplus remaining after one’s own and dependents’ necessary expenses.", "reasons": "FARRA (author): العفو is the surplus wealth one spends; al-Farrāʾ says the zakāt obligation later abrogated this ruling.
